tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures point to a thermal-fin bridge and flux conservation, but the recalled bridge note does not specify the quantitative law. A discriminating open-branch measurement is needed before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a fin-bridge or alternative saturating law immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations vary only u_now, leaving the bridge mechanism and dependence on other inputs unidentified.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly targets the unresolved mechanism.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism-identification ambiguity.
